title: Barbie Girl
credit: Barbie Girl (Aqua), melody-line sheet with solfège syllables, arranger unknown
_notation: Per hand, one string per bar. Tokens: pitch (G4, F#4, C5), rest r. Suffix :n = length in eighths (default 1; fractions like 1/2 allowed). Prefix ~ = tied from the previous token of the same pitch (no new attack). Every bar must sum to 8 eighths. Single-staff source: the whole melody is in rh, lh is whole-bar rests. Repeats written out: printed bars 1-8 are indices 1-8 and 9-16; printed 9-29 are 17-37; printed 30-33 are 38-41 and 42-45; printed 34-40 are 46-52.

sections.name: Verse
sections.hint: "I'm a Barbie girl, in a Barbie world": si-sol-si-MI-DO, then la-fa#-la-RE-si. Right hand only; the left hand rests throughout the piece. Watch the rests that open bars 3, 4 and 7.
sections.coach: Right hand alone: two four-bar phrases. Count the rest at the start of bars 3 and 4.

sections.name: Verse, repeat
sections.hint: The printed repeat of bars 1-8, note for note. Bar 13 has the dotted DO (C5) that bar 9 did not.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.hint: "Come on Barbie, let's go party": a half rest, then sol-la-si eighths that tie across every bar line. Each first note of a bar is held over from the bar before, so the attacks are on the off-beats. In bars 21 and 24, sol is held into the bar and the two eighth rests come mid-bar.
sections.coach: Every bar starts tied over: keep the finger down across the bar line and attack on the and.

sections.name: Ah-ah-ah yeah
sections.hint: The high answer: si-DO-RE, then MI-si-RE, MI-DO-RE, RE-MI-RE-RE, all tied across the bar lines, up to the two sixteenths and the held la (A4) in bar 29.
sections.coach: Rest-heavy bars: count the eighth rests aloud, and hold every tied RE into the next bar.

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.hint: The verse again, identical to bars 1-8.

sections.name: Bridge
sections.hint: "You can brush my hair": sol-sol-mi-re twice, then RE-si-sol-mi-re with eighth rests, then the MI-RE-MI figure on the top space. re is D4, just below the staff.
sections.coach: Low sol-sol-mi-re: the re is D4 below the staff. Then the high MI-RE-MI answers.

sections.name: Chorus 2
sections.hint: The chorus again, bars 17-23 note for note. The sheet ends here on the tied la (A4), so the last bar is bar 52.
sections.coach: Same tied chorus as before; finish on the la and let it ring.
